convert_fieldmask_to_json_string: convert a FieldMask protobuf message to its JSON string representation using ToJsonString
parse_fieldmask_from_json_string: parse a comma-separated JSON string into a FieldMask protobuf message using FromJsonString
validate_fieldmask_against_descriptor: validate whether a FieldMask is valid for a given protobuf message descriptor using IsValidForDescriptor
merge_messages_with_fieldmask: merge specified fields from a source message to a destination message using MergeMessage with a FieldMask
compute_fieldmask_union: compute the union of two FieldMask messages into a single FieldMask using the Union method
